meta.title: Ise Osamu | Producer · Painter · Tea Practitioner
meta.description: Portfolio of Ise Osamu — a producer, painter, and tea practitioner based in Miyota, Nagano, Japan.

about.bio:
Born in 1983. CEO of Play Inc.
Co-operator of "Bokete," Japan's largest crowd-sourced comedy platform.
Active as a painter and tea practitioner.
Advocates "Fukusen Shikō" (Foreshadowing Thinking) — a framework for re-reading past experiences as narrative foreshadowing.

art.title: Art
art.subtitle: Painting
art.description: Creating mixed-media paintings using gold leaf, silver leaf, and sulfurization techniques. Exploring the interplay between chance and intention through the transformation of natural materials over time.
art.exhibitions: Venice Biennale related exhibition (May 2026, Palazzo Pisani Santa Marina)

tea.title: Tea
tea.subtitle: Tea Practice
tea.description: Through the way of tea, creating ephemeral spaces of encounter — ichigo ichie — between people and place.

activities.name: LIFE Tea ART
activities.detail: A workshop combining tea ceremony with life timelines (Miyota Living Lab)

philosophy.body:
A framework for re-reading past events not as mere occurrences, but as foreshadowing in the narrative of your life.
Product, painting, tea — seemingly disparate pursuits, all connected by a single thread.
